pick.headline: Daniloff freed and leaves Moscow
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of October 1, 1986, carried Moscow TASS in English announcing that Daniloff was "expelled" from the USSR on September 29, alongside Zakharov's release and the Reykjavik meeting.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, Vol. III No. 190, 1 October 1986
